Module aparicio.firstscreen
Package aparicio.controller

Class MainController

java.lang.Object
aparicio.controller.MainController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class MainController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
This class creates the main screen for the Inventory Management System. It contains all features and buttons and redirects to new screens.

    • onAddPart

      public void onAddPart(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method is called when the Add button for Parts is clicked. This method opens up the Add Parts screen.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • onModifyPart

      public void onModifyPart(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method is called when the Modify button for Parts is clicked. This method reads the part selected and opens up the Modify Parts screen with the part selected data populated. It also checks to see if the part selected is In-House or Outsourced and redirects to appropriate screen.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • onDeletePart

      public void onDeletePart(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method is called when the Parts Delete button is clicked. This method deletes the part that is selected. If no selection is made, will display Alert message.

    • onInvPartsSearch

      public void onInvPartsSearch(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method searches the Parts list. It calls the lookUpPart method from Inventory Model class, returns a list of matches and searches by Part ID and Name. RUNTIME ERROR: A runtime error occurs when the user enters text that does not match a part from the parts list into the Search text field. This was fixed by adding a try/catch block.

    • onAddProduct

      public void onAddProduct(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException

      Throws:

    • onModifyProduct

      public void onModifyProduct(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method is called when the Modify button for Products is clicked. This method reads the Product selected and opens up the Modify Products screen with the Product selected data populated.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • onInvProductsSearch

      public void onInvProductsSearch(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method searches the Products list. It calls the lookUpProduct method from Inventory Model class, returns a list of matches and searches by Product ID and Name. RUNTIME ERROR: A runtime error occurs when the user enters text that does not match a product from the products list into the Search text field. This was fixed by adding a try/catch block.

    • onDeleteProduct

      public void onDeleteProduct(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method is called when the Products Delete button is clicked. This method deletes the product that is selected. If no selection is made, will display Alert message.
